extension.summary: Nuvio backend and complete local Nuvio build installer.
extension.description: Backend for the independent Nuvio interface and Kodi skin. Metadata add-ons supply catalog metadata; individually enabled stream add-ons supply sources in their original order. Includes local component installation, account sync, Continue Watching and playback services. Manual bundle ZIP updates only.
extension.disclaimer: The author of this addon does not host any of the content which is found and has no affiliation with any of the content providers. The author is in no way affiliated with Kodi, Team Kodi, or the XBMC Foundation.
extension.news: Nuvio Hub 6.0.16 test candidate: automatic updates from the GitHub releases (verified, with backup), Ko-fi support QR in Settings, Home follows the catalogs of your own add-ons and Cinemeta is used only when nothing else is set (switchable under Metadata add-ons, bundled offline manifest), seamless looping video screensaver, black frame around small video on CoreELEC and in the IPTV guide, one HUB button in IPTV, background work yields to what you open and more posters are kept in RAM. Device acceptance remains required.
